sentences.en: Frontline workers bear the brunt of the pandemic’s risk.
sentences.zh: 前线工人承受了疫情的主要风险。

sentences.en: The brunt of criticism was borne by the chairmen.
sentences.zh: 批评主要落在了董事长身上。

sentences.en: Coastal cities will take the brunt of the storm.
sentences.zh: 沿海城市将承担这场风暴的主要影响。

senses.zh: （来自攻击一方的）主要力量,撞击，进攻,冲击
